text:
Copper(II) chloride crystals are made by adding solid copper(II) carbonate to dilute
hydrochloric acid until no more dissolves.
Which process is used to obtain pure copper(II) chloride crystals from the mixture?
A
distillation of the mixture
B
evaporation of the mixture
C
filtration followed by drying of the residue
D
filtration followed by evaporation of the filtrate

options.label: C
options.text: filtration followed by drying of the residue

options.label: D
options.text: filtration followed by evaporation of the filtrate
